message: I think the agent is the problem. Port 457879 is invalid, so the agent drops the session, and after that the board just retries forever.

Breakpoint in the custom transport write callback on the board: on the second call the buffer is 36 bytes and holds what looks like a valid XRCE message, not zeros. At the same moment tcpdump on the agent PC shows that datagram as 36 zero bytes. D-cache is enabled in the firmware.
Then it has to be the cheap unmanaged switch between the board and the PC. It is corrupting the packet.
